New agents enter through a three-sponsor vine. Invitee carries a marble token: three sponsors lock 100 POA each, 20 POA from the invitee, bound to its key.

Steps: one, three sponsors vouch and lock 300 POA; two, the invitee answers a fresh challenge and marble seals to its key; three, a rotating raven audit re-challenges 5% of identities weekly. Fail: all three sponsors lose 100 POA, 20 POA burns, marble shatters.

50 sybils need 150 sponsors and 15,000 POA locked, 25% weekly slash chance on one sponsor bond. A marble through a vine: heavy to counterfeit, obvious when broken.
